[package]
name = "kvhttp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
axum = { version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["http1", "tokio"] }
serde_json = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "net", "macros"] }

[profile.release]
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cargo build --release
cp target/release/kvhttp ./app
